repo.name: core
repo.description: AdonisJS is a TypeScript-first web framework for building web apps and API servers. It comes with support for testing, modern tooling, an ecosystem of official packages, and more.

readme.summary: The README is essentially a marketing landing page with no actionable documentation — it identifies the project as a Node.js MVC framework but provides zero installation, usage, or configuration content.
readme.top_issue: No installation instructions, quick start, examples, or configuration docs — the entire README defers to an external website with no inline guidance whatsoever.

security.summary: The code appears to handle security concerns effectively with proper input validation and no evident injection risks or exposed secrets.

common_complaints: v7 migration breaking changes (serialize property removed from HttpContext)
File system watcher failures preventing dev server hot reload
Documentation mismatches (encryption driver name, logger typo, .gitignore guidance)
Monorepo and Docker production build failures in v7
sentiment.summary: Active community with strong appreciation for the framework, but v7 migration introduced multiple integration issues affecting user setup and development workflows, though most reported problems are being addressed.

red_flags: Some responses are brief and could be more detailed
A few responses require additional context from the user
communication.summary: The maintainer provides helpful and welcoming responses, often with clear instructions or code snippets. However, some answers could benefit from more detail to fully address issues.

concerns: No commits merged in past 6 months despite recent commit timestamp
Zero issues closed in past 6 months
Contradictory activity data suggests data collection issues
positive_signals: Recent commit 2 days ago indicates possible resurrection
maintenance.summary: Package appears abandoned with zero maintenance activity over 6 months, though a recent commit suggests possible revival or data collection anomaly.

risk_factors: Publisher 'GitHub Actions' not in maintainers list
